'''2009 Worlds Day 2 Scott Lingrell LS Careful Planning''' was the Light Side constructed list played by [[Scott Lingrell]] at [[2009 World Championship]] (Day 2).

== Deck info ==

* '''Starting Card:''' [[Careful Planning / A New Secret Base|Careful Planning / A New Secret Base (V)]]
* '''Format:''' [[Legacy Open]]
* '''Stage:''' Day 2
